name: ELEMENTAL
author: amnmkkr
description: A modal synthesis voice: the DSP of Elements, Emilie Gillet's modal synthesizer for Mutable Instruments, run unchanged at its own 32 kHz and resampled to 48 kHz. Struck, bowed and blown resonators, a string and sympathetic strings, its reverb and the hidden ominous voice. Not affiliated with Mutable Instruments.
